summary: Whether you show it or not, a strong will and deep reserves of energy and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you go after what you want and don't back down and you reach, grow, and lift the room. At the edge, your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it, then blow up at whoever is closest.
